papers.title: Adaptive Submodular Ranking and Routing
papers.abstract: We study a general stochastic ranking problem where an algorithm needs to adaptively select a sequence of elements so as to "cover" a random scenario (drawn from a known distribution) at minimum expected cost. The coverage of each scenario is captured by an individual submodular function, where the scenario is said to be covered when its function value goes above a given threshold. We obtain a logarithmic factor approximation algorithm for this adaptive ranking problem, which is the best possible (unless P=NP). This problem unifies and generalizes many previously studied problems with applications in search ranking and active learning. The approximation ratio of our algorithm either matches or improves the best result known in each of these special cases. Furthermore, we extend our results to an adaptive vehicle routing problem, where costs are determined by an underlying metric. This routing problem is a significant generalization of the previously-studied adaptive traveling salesman and traveling repairman problems. Our approximation ratio nearly matches the best bound known for these special cases. Finally, we present experimental results for some applications of adaptive ranking.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究自适应排序问题以最小化覆盖随机场景的期望成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出对数因子近似算法，结合子模函数和自适应选择。
summary_zh.result: 算法在多个特例中达到或改进已知最优比。
summary_zh.validation: 在搜索排序和主动学习应用中进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This paper studies a general stochastic ranking problem to minimize expected cost of covering random scenarios with submodular functions.
summary_en.method: A logarithmic factor approximation algorithm is proposed for adaptive ranking, unifying and generalizing several previous problems.
summary_en.result: The approximation ratio matches or improves the best known results in various special cases.
summary_en.validation: Experimental results are presented for applications including search ranking and active learning.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了AlSi10Mg铝合金的选择性激光熔化及拉伸过程中的应力分配，与生物医用植入物的应力遮挡、疲劳等方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue, or any biomedical context; it focuses on aluminum alloy for non-biomedical structural applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备AlSi10Mg合金在拉伸时的应力分配行为
summary_zh.method: 使用原位中子衍射测量各相晶格应变，分析应力分配
summary_zh.result: 揭示了Al基体与Si共晶间的应力转移机制
summary_zh.validation: 通过原位中子衍射实验验证应力分配模型

summary_en.motivation: To understand the stress partitioning behavior between phases during tensile deformation of additively manufactured AlSi10Mg alloy.
summary_en.method: In situ neutron diffraction was used to measure lattice strains in individual phases during tensile testing of SLM-produced AlSi10Mg.
summary_en.result: The Al matrix and Si eutectic exhibited distinct load-sharing characteristics, with stress transfer from Al to Si upon plastic deformation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via in situ neutron diffraction combined with tensile testing.

papers.title: Active Learning berbasis Teknologi Informasi (ICT)
papers.abstract: Penerapan pembelajaran aktif di perguruan tinggi didasarkan pada prinsip bahwa cara belajar terbaik bagi mahasiswa adalah dengan melakukan, dengan menggunakan semua inderanya dan dengan mengeksplorasi lingkungannya yang terdiri atas orang, hal, tempat dan kejadian yang terjadi dalam kehidupan nyata (pembelajaran kontekstual dan pemecahan masalah). Untuk memfasilitasi pembelajaran aktif, dosen harus menggunakan berbagai strategi yang aktif dan kontekstual, melibatkan pembelajaran bersama (cooperative learning) dan mengakomodasi perbedaan jender dan gaya belajar masing-masing mahasiswa dengan tujuan untuk memaksimalkan kemampuan pembelajar dalam memahami hal baru dan dapat menggunakan informasi baru tersebut dalam kehidupan mereka sehari-hari. Teknologi informasi, meliputi segala hal yang berkaitan dengan proses, penggunaan sebagai alat bantu, manipulasi, dan pengelolaan informasi. Sementara teknologi komunikasi merupakan segala hal yang berkaitan dengan penggunaan alat bantu untuk memproses dan mentransfer data dari perangkat yang satu ke lainnya. Pembelajaran aktif sesungguhnya adalah bagaimana membuat proses pembelajaran itu lebih berpusat kepada mahasiswa yang aktif dengan memanfaatkan teknologi informasi atau ICT Component.

papers.title: Complicações pós‐artroplastia total de quadril em portadores e não portadores de diabetes mellitus controlado durante a internação
papers.abstract: Avaliar a associação entre as complicações pós‐ATQ e DM controlado no período da internação. Pesquisa de corte transversal por meio da análise de prontuários retrospectivos de um hospital particular em Salvador (BA). Usaram‐se os testes qui‐quadrado e exato de Fisher no programa estatístico SAS. A maioria dos pacientes era do sexo feminino e idosa. As comorbidades mais prevalentes da amostra foram hipertensão arterial sistêmica e DM. A patologia de base mais frequente na amostra foi coxartrose; já entre os pacientes com DM, foi fratura do colo do fêmur. As complicações mais comuns foram alterações do sistema hemolinfopoiético. Dentre essas anemia foi a complicação mais frequente. As complicações do aparelho cardiovascular, do sistema nervoso e as glicêmicas tiveram associação positiva com o DM controlado. Já as complicações hemolinfopoiéticas, geniturinárias, digestórias, eletrolíticas e infecciosas não apresentaram associação com DM. Ser portador de DM foi um fator protetor de complicações térmicas. Não houve diferença estatisticamente significante entre os pacientes portadores e não portadores de DM em nenhum dos grupos de complicações estudados. Os pacientes portadores de DM controlado não apresentaram mais complicações dos que os pacientes não portadores de DM durante a internação no pós‐operatório da ATQ Total hip arthroplasty (THA) is a procedure that aims to restore the function of the hip joint. Diabetes mellitus (DM) is one of the most prevalent comorbidities among patients undergoing THA. DM involves various immunological and metabolic aspects, which lead to limitations and surgical complications. To evaluate the association between THA complications and controlled DM during hospitalization period. Cross‐sectional research through the analysis of retrospective records of a private hospital in Salvador, Bahia. The chi‐squared and Fisher's exact tests were used in SAS statistical program. Most patients were elderly females). The most prevalent comorbidities in the sample were hypertension and diabetes. The most frequent underlying pathology in the sample was coxarthrosis; among patients with DM, it was femoral neck fracture. The most common complications were changes in the hemolymphopoietic system, among which anemia was the most frequent complication. Cardiovascular, nervous, and blood glucose complications were positively associated with controlled DM. In turn, hemolymphopoietic, genitourinary, digestive, electrolyte, and infectious complications were not associated with DM. Having DM was a protective factor for thermal complications. There was no statistically significant difference between patients that had or did not have DM in each complication group studied. Patients with controlled DM did not present more complications than those without DM during hospitalization in the post THA.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注糖尿病对全髋关节置换术后住院并发症的影响，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical retrospective study on postoperative complications in diabetic patients, with no biomechanical modeling, no implant stress analysis, no micromotion, and no FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估控制糖尿病对全髋关节置换术后住院并发症的影响
summary_zh.method: 回顾性病历分析，使用卡方检验和Fisher精确检验
summary_zh.result: 控制糖尿病患者术后并发症发生率与非糖尿病患者无显著差异
summary_zh.validation: 基于病历数据的统计分析

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the association between controlled diabetes mellitus and postoperative complications during hospitalization after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A cross-sectional retrospective chart review with chi-squared and Fisher's exact tests was conducted.
summary_en.result: Patients with controlled diabetes did not show significantly higher complication rates compared to non-diabetic patients.
summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis of clinical records from a single private hospital.
